variant: rel_os + meter on the generator grid (ctx.timing); chosen because no Features v4 proxy was within -.01 AUC of rel_os (rel_proxy.log)
model: sklearn LogisticRegression(C=1, max_iter=400); score = intercept + sum(coef[i] * x[i]); probability = 1 / (1 + exp(-score)); rank candidates by score
rank: Every column is turned into a within-song rank before scoring. Columns with more than 2 distinct values in the song: average rank (ties get the mean of their ranks, 1-based) divided by the number of candidates n of that song, so the values lie in (0, 1]. Columns with at most 2 distinct values (the binary meter flags) stay raw. Same as common.rank_cols; scipy.stats.rankdata(method='average') / n.
candidates: 30 ms clusters of Features v4 onsets (extract.candidates); label = a human note of that level within 35 ms
